To win over the members, Sundarlal offers ₹1 lakh cash rent to the society fund and promises free entry, food, and entertainment for all residents. To further prove his commitment, he unexpectedly hands Bhide an extra ₹1 lakh for decorations on the spot.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
